correctness.rationale: Every one of the 4096 subsets satisfies two independently coded equivalent face tests; 3098 nonempty simplices produce 1542 matched covering pairs with a single critical vertex and thirteen six-cells. All 16648 covering relations are enumerated and the reversed matched Hasse graph has a complete topological ordering; Forman gives integral wedge of thirteen six-spheres. Exhaustive graph automorphism enumeration yields eight D4 elements, exact reduced signed Lefschetz traces give the eight character values, and inner products give the rational irreducible multiplicities. Separate mod-two boundary ranks are corroborative only. A complete standalone replay is embedded.

source_inspections.title: The smallest triangle-free 4-chromatic 4-regular graph

value.rationale: A canonical smallest four-regular triangle-free four-chromatic graph motivates the natural domination-complement complex; thirteen exact integral six-spheres and an explicit full rational D4 representation go beyond domination numbers, Euler characteristics, finite-field Betti ranks and previously known independence/neighborhood two-sphere data. This is an exact, self-contained meaningful small-graph topology benchmark with a strict general connectivity inequality, not an arbitrary slice.
